We always thought Ravana was just a legend... No one could come venture into the Abandoned Temple here because it was sealed. It was only after the demon awakened that the path opened, which is why--

yes.0: There is nothing more mind-numbing than the battle cry of a #b#o8144005##k. Eliminate #e#b100#k#n of them in #r#m252020300# and #m252020400##k.
